# Monsoons

> Monsoons is an AI visibility company in Mesa, Arizona. We get local East Valley
> businesses named and recommended by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini,
> Perplexity) when nearby customers ask who to hire. Free audit, results-based
> pricing, and no results means no payment.

Contact: 480-289-1294
Service area: Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler, Tempe, Queen Creek and Apache Junction, Arizona.

## What we do

We publish factual written coverage of a client's business across news and industry
sites, build out their Google Business Profile, and make their business information
consistent everywhere an answer engine checks. Then we measure whether the engines
started naming them, using ten fresh runs per question across three platforms.

## Who we serve

Restaurants, cafes, bars, bakeries, salons and barbers, nail salons, med spas,
dentists, chiropractors, gyms, auto repair, boutiques and other storefront businesses
in East Valley strip malls and plazas. Also home service trades: junk removal, turf
and landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, garage doors, pest control and
pool service.

## Pricing

- Audit: free. Five questions run across three answer engines with screenshots.
- Get you in the answer: $1,000. $250 deposit, balance owed only on agreed results.
- Google profile setup: $400.
- New website, built to be machine readable: from $2,500.
- Ongoing monthly coverage and measurement: $500 per month, cancel any month.

Minimum for a build is $900.

## The guarantee

The balance is owed when three of five agreed questions show the client's business
cited or recommended in at least five of ten fresh runs, on at least two of three
named answer engines, within thirty days. A miss means a second campaign at our cost.
A second miss means the balance is refunded.

## What we do not claim

We do not promise first place, because answer engines do not return ranked lists. We
do not promise permanence. We do not promise inclusion in model training data. We do
not guarantee a number of leads or a revenue figure. We guarantee citation in answers.

## Partners

QuarterSmart, an AI studio in Mesa, Arizona, for AI automation, workflow builds and
staff training. https://quartersmart.com
